_meta.indication: TIVDAK is indicated for the treatment of adult patients with recurrent or metastatic cervical cancer with disease progression on or after chemotherapy (accelerated approval).

pivotal_trials.population: 101 patients with recurrent or metastatic cervical cancer who had received ≤2 prior lines of systemic treatment in the metastatic setting, including doublet chemotherapy, with bevacizumab if eligible
pivotal_trials.endpoint: Primary endpoint was confirmed overall response rate (ORR) assessed by an independent review committee (IRC) per RECIST v1.1; DOR was a secondary endpoint
pivotal_trials.result: Confirmed ORR 23.8% (95% CI: 15.9%, 33.3%); median DOR 8.3 months (95% CI: 4.2, NR)

key_safety: Fatal adverse reactions occurred in 4% (septic shock, pneumonitis); serious adverse reactions in 43% (ileus 6%, hemorrhage 5%, pneumonia 4%). Most common adverse reactions (≥30%) included fatigue, nausea, peripheral neuropathy, alopecia, epistaxis, conjunctival adverse reactions, and hemorrhage. Ocular toxicity affected 55% of patients, including 6% with ulcerative keratitis.
target_moa: Tisotumab vedotin is a tissue factor (TF)-directed antibody-drug conjugate: a human anti-TF IgG1 kappa antibody linked via a protease-cleavable valine-citrulline linker to the microtubule-disrupting agent monomethyl auristatin E (MMAE), which induces cell cycle arrest and apoptosis.

boxed_warning.content: Boxed Warning for ocular toxicity: TIVDAK caused changes in the corneal epithelium and conjunctiva resulting in changes in vision, including severe vision loss, and corneal ulceration.

companion_dx_detail: No companion diagnostic is required; the indication is regardless of tumor TF status and TF expression was not required for enrollment.

advisory_committee.vote: FDA did not refer this application to an advisory committee as there were no efficacy or safety issues identified during the review which required external input for the proposed indication.

description.text: Converted accelerated approval to regular (full) approval for recurrent or metastatic cervical cancer with disease progression on or after chemotherapy

citations.quote: This Prior Approval supplemental biologics license application provides for regular approval of TIVDAK for the treatment of adult patients with recurrent or metastatic cervical cancer with disease progression on or after chemotherapy.

surrogate_endpoint.text: Tumor response rate (confirmed ORR) and durability of response (DOR).

citations.quote: This indication is approved under accelerated approval based on tumor response rate and durability of response.

confirmatory_requirement.text: Conduct innovaTV 301, a randomized trial comparing tisotumab vedotin to investigator's choice chemotherapy, and provide final OS and PFS analyses to verify clinical benefit.

citations.quote: 4131-1 Conduct the clinical trial innovaTV 301 titled, "Tisotumab Vedotin versus Chemotherapy in Recurrent or Metastatic Cervical Cancer" and provide the final overall survival (OS) and progression-free survival (PFS) analyses to describe and verify the clinical benefit of tisotumab vedotin in patients with recurrent or metastatic cervical cancer.
